infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Coachie records model replies for your A/B conversations.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Coachie transcribes model replies for your conversations.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Coachie uses your camera when you take a photo to extract a scenario.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow InterviewCoach to access your microphone to record interview answers.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Coachie to read a selected screenshot to extract its scenario.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Coachie to photograph a scenario for text extraction.
